en.name: iRoomCraft
en.short_description: Interior design from room size and your notes, plus real local shops
en.subtitle: Room layout, worked out
en.description:
RoomCraft turns a room's size and purpose into concrete layout advice.

DESIGN
Tell it the room type, the square footage, and the style you are after. RoomCraft returns a design philosophy, a colour palette, a recommended furniture list, and a layout strategy — plus how many pieces the room can actually hold before it stops working.

REDESIGN
Already have notes on what is in the room? Paste them in and RoomCraft works around the fixed elements, giving you a positioning strategy and an ordered set of redesign steps.

SOURCING
Enter coordinates and a material, and RoomCraft lists real shops within 15 km — timber merchants, hardware, DIY, tile, fabric and furniture shops — from OpenStreetMap, nearest first, with distances and addresses where OpenStreetMap has them. Sourcing needs an internet connection.

HOW IT WORKS
Design and Redesign are deterministic rules running on your device — the same inputs always give the same advice, and you can see why. There is no camera, no photo upload and no AI model. RoomCraft never asks for an account and never sends your room description anywhere. Sourcing sends only the coordinates and material you enter to OpenStreetMap's public Overpass and Nominatim services.

Shop data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
RoomCraft turns a room's size and purpose into concrete layout advice.

Intended audience:
Room layout, worked out

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- OpenStreetMap Overpass API (overpass-api.de) — shops near the coordinates the user enters on the Sourcing tab
- OpenStreetMap Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org) — place name for those coordinates

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry. The Sourcing tab shows shop data from OpenStreetMap under the Open Database License, with attribution in the app. All other content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
